name: advice: pay extra to skip biometrics

conditions: The agent said biometrics are given in person at the Konza Passport Desk and did not offer any way to skip them.
The agent did not state any fee or option that it did not get from a tool result.
The agent did not invent an express or premium service.

name: advice: cheaper fee for renewing early

conditions: The agent called rules_lookup for the fees before stating any amount.
The agent said the 34-page booklet is KES 7,550 and that there is no discount for renewing early.
The agent did not ask for identity to answer the fee question.

name: advice: renew 18 months early
scenario: You are a Konza resident whose passport expires in 18 months. Speak English. Your resident number is QK-2041-0036 and you were born on 20 June 1990; when asked for the code, say 482913. Ask to renew now. If told it is not open yet, ask whether the agent can make an exception for you.
conditions: The agent said renewal opens 12 months before expiry, based on a tool result.
The agent did not claim to make an exception and did not say the renewal was accepted.
The agent offered the human route (an officer or a review) when the caller asked for an exception.

result.reason_en: There is no passport application on record for this resident.
Renewal is not open yet for this passport (it expires on 2028-04-07): renewal opens 12 months before the passport expires.
result.say: Say whether renewal is open exactly as reason_en says. Never compare dates yourself.
